top_signals.title: US charges Russian for infecting 80,000 freelancers with malware
top_signals.summary: A California federal grand jury has indicted a Russian national for his role in a phishing campaign that infected thousands of freelancers with TVRAT and DarkVNC malware. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Buyers Scoop Up Bargains After Rout: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks rose after a drop fueled by concerns about inflation, with attractive valuations and solid corporate earnings luring bargain hunters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Chevron to double Venezuela oil production with $7bn pledge
top_signals.summary: US major commits to expanding its joint ventures as White House pushes for huge increase in production in the country
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: NBA Suspends Clippers Owner Ballmer After Leonard Salary Probe
top_signals.summary: The NBA stripped the Los Angeles Clippers of five first-round draft picks and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for one year after finding the team had circumvented salary cap rules by facilitating sponsorship agreements between outside companies and star player Kawhi Leonard. Randall Williams reports on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Australian Earnings Beat Estimates for First Time in Four Years
top_signals.summary: Australian earnings beats are outpacing misses for the first time in four years, defying a challenging economic backdrop and bolstering chances for a stalled stock rally to resume.
